chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a woman who sees that a man has intercourse with her in a dream in her private part until she emits fluid. He said: She performs ghusl (ritual bath).

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl after a sexual dream if she emits fluid?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that when a woman emits fluid due to a sexual dream, ghusl becomes obligatory upon her. It indicates that the ruling applies based on discharge occurring in sleep, establishing a principle of ritual purity in such cases.
